name: Tide of Glass
body:
School evocation; Level druid 3, magus 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a shard of glass)

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a blast of tiny, dangerously-sharp shards of glass. Any creature within the cone take 1d6 magical slashing damage per caster level (maximum 10d6).

Additionally, any creature that takes damage takes 1 bleed damage on a successful saving throw and 1d4 bleed on a failed one.
